# Historical Profile Backup v1

`legacy-v1.botharness-backup` was generated once with the unmodified Profile Backup writer from commit `dd6da4645afcd17ab1a265c293d5928952deb016`, before the #2794 writer change. It is a permanent input, not regenerated by the tests. Its database Schema Generation is 106, its declared DSH producer is `0.2.0-rc.1`, and its BotHarness producer is the synthetic value `test`.

The existing Profile Backup test scene supplied only synthetic Bots, Memory, an editable attachment, ended Channel history, a purged message, deleted-retained/erased identities and an old Orchestrator ownership reference. It includes no actual user conversations or credentials. Its source paths use a disposable generic `C:/botharness-fixture` root, not a personal directory. The sidecar records synthetic identities used to verify recovery.

The test reads this file through the production reader, restores it into a new Profile, and verifies identity, content, Purge and cold execution across restart. Keep this fixture when changing the writer. Add a separate fixture for future historical formats rather than updating this file to make a regression pass.
